subject: Full Petri audit transcripts now committed (runs/petri/cache)
body: e7c26ea2: .gitignore now tracks runs/petri/cache/ (rest of runs/ still scratch). It holds the full target transcript + raw reasoning over all branches + Petri scores for the 2026-11-15 stock-vs-control pilot on Kimi K2.6, dev n=12 (24 audits). The results JSONs clip reasoning to 1,500 chars; use these for full CoT. The 11-14 baseline's full logs were in a tempdir and are gone. Future c2_e3b runs with --cache-dir under runs/petri/cache/ will also be tracked: don't point it at anything with secrets.
